notes: For Claude: it lists every break along a pipe (couplings, set ups and downs, branches, drops, ends), checks fittings against the drawing itself, follows a tag's leader line to its pipe, traces a big system run by run, and can take pictures without the length labels. Claude's questions now show as numbered pins, and the bottom bar takes you to each one. View > Lines Underneath shows the drawing's own lines that Claude reads. Settings > Templates folder can keep your templates and Claude's rules on OneDrive so both PCs share them.
